evidence:
Built the requirement -> criterion map from instruction.md + hireops_rules.md + integration.md against all 52 criteria (2 gates, 40 functional, 5 polish, 5 visual). Most of the brief is well covered, often with server replays and positive controls: one-stage moves (hro_move_one_stage), arrival at bottom (hro_arrive_bottom), reorder shared (hro_reorder), reject/reason/rejected-from (hro_reject_reason, hro_reject_hired), reopen + undo restores reason (hro_reopen), Interview places incl. reorder-in-full and freed place and undo overfill (hro_interview_full, hro_interview_reorder_free, hro_undo_full), refused put-back with reason and focus (hro_refused_put_back), stale 409 naming who (hro_stale_refused), bulk all-or-none and places (hro_bulk_*), undo restores/conflict/once (hro_undo_*), activity kinds/order/filter/refusals (hro_activity*), notes perms (hro_notes), live board (hro_live_board) and preservation (hro_pol_live_board), messaging/Enter/Shift+Enter/focus (hro_msg_*), 30-page window, earlier pages and anchor (hro_thread_latest, hro_thread_earlier, hro_pol_earlier_place), unread per person and scrolled-up notice (hro_unread_*), seen incl. Observer exclusion (hro_seen), conversation access (hro_thread_access), drafts incl. session end and other-user isolation (hro_drafts, hro_pol_session_resume, hro_pol_failed_send), candidate wording/ownership/privacy/linking (hro_candidate_*), 401 anonymous (hro_anonymous), restart persistence and idempotent seed (hro_restart); runtime entry/port/DB_PATH/health readiness enforced by test.sh lines 97-125. Bundling several legs per criterion is the documented flow exception and is not reported. GAPS (asked-for behaviour that no criterion observes, so a broken app keeps full credit):
(G1, most material) Candidate read refusals for the board and Activity. hireops_rules.md line 193: 'The board, the Activity view and every staff action are refused to candidates.' hro_candidate_no_staff (functional judge.toml lines 176-183) replays only writes (move, add-candidate, open-job, note). hro_candidate_private (lines 384-390) inspects only responses the candidate page itself receives and replays only 'the staff notes or card-detail read'. Protocol K (functional prompt.md line 43) likewise. No criterion replays a board read or an Activity read in a candidate session.
(G2) Hiring-manager limits outside the forward early moves. Rules lines 70-72: a manager moves 'only among Interview, Offer and Hired', may 'reject from Interview or Offer and reopen a card that was rejected from one of those. Everything else is refused for them.' hro_mgr_early_refused (lines 150-156) and protocol R (prompt.md line 45) only try Applied->Screen and Screen->Interview plus open-job/add-candidate. Interview->Screen by a manager, a manager rejecting from Applied/Screen, and a manager reopening a card rejected from Applied/Screen are never tried.
(G3) User-visible half of the stale-move refusal. instruction.md line 3: 'put the card back where it really is and tell me why; when it is because a colleague moved that card a moment ago, tell me who'; rules lines 78-80: 'The person is told ... by whom, and their board shows the card where it really is.' hro_stale_refused (lines 194-201) is graded on a page.evaluate replay and accepts the name 'in the response or on screen'; no criterion makes a UI move from a stale board and checks the on-screen message names the colleague or that the card is re-placed. (hro_refused_put_back covers only the full-Interview refusal.)
(G4) Successful multi-card move from different stages and its cross-stage arrival order. Rules lines 89-91: cards 'from any of its stages' arrive 'by stage in the order listed above, then by place within the stage.' hro_bulk_move and protocol B steps 3/6/8 only move sets whose members share a stage (Applied or Screen); the only mixed-stage set (V Screen + Z Applied, step 5) is the refused one.
(G5, minor) Undo exceptions/conditions: 'Adding a note does not count as a change' (rules line 99) is never exercised (no note between a move and its undo); invalidation by another person's re-order/reject/reopen is only exercised via another person's move (hro_undo_conflict). Note drafts 'kept for that person' (rules line 106): only reload persistence is graded (hro_pol_failed_send); isolation from another account on the same browser is graded only for message drafts. 'If they are at the newest message, it is shown and counts as read' (rules line 157) is not read back after arrival (hro_msg_exchange / hro_pol_live_thread check display, not unread state). Seen for a candidate message via the job's hiring manager, and Observer opening not marking a candidate's message seen (rules lines 165-166), are untested (only staff-message Observer case). Exact statuses 403 (rules line 22) and 409 (line 78) are not graded (refusal is). Runtime: 'GET /api/health ... never touches the database' and 'start with no shipped database' (instruction lines 13, 15) are not observed by any criterion or test.sh readiness probe; seeded notes and seeded per-stage card order are never read back.
Conforming-alternative check: none of the gaps cause a false fail; they are under-coverage only. Template comparison: template functional judge.toml carries a 'change_me' + 'persistence' skeleton; the task's criteria are task-specific and do not alter shared harness or scoring.toml.
counterexample: Broken app that keeps full credit on every criterion: (a) GET board and GET activity routes check only 'signed in', not staff role, so Tomas's session can fetch every candidate's card, board positions, rejection reasons and the activity log; the candidate UI never calls them, so hro_candidate_private's passive inspection and its notes/card-detail replay see nothing, and hro_candidate_no_staff replays only writes. (b) Hiring-manager permission implemented as 'source stage must be Interview/Offer/Hired' for moves and no stage check on reject: Ingrid's Applied->Screen and Screen->Interview are refused (hro_mgr_early_refused passes) while she can drag a card Interview->Screen or reject a Screen card. (c) Stale UI move shows a generic 'Move failed' toast while only the JSON body carries changedBy: hro_stale_refused passes via 'in the response'. (d) Bulk move that rejects or mis-orders mixed-stage selections still passes hro_bulk_move.
suggested_fix: Add to protocol K/hro_candidate_private a replay in Tomas's session of the observed staff board read and Activity read (both refused, no data); extend protocol R/hro_mgr_early_refused with Ingrid trying Interview->Screen and rejecting a Screen card on J1 (refused, unchanged); require the stale refusal's naming on screen (or add a UI stale move before the live update lands); add one successful mixed-stage multi-card move to protocol B and check stage-then-place arrival order; optionally cover undo-after-note and read-at-newest — re-checking workload, since adding legs adds judge time.
